prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A flat 2D cartoon mascot of a chubby giraffe caught in a huge, uncontrollable belly laugh, designed like a goofy chat-app reaction sticker. The character is extremely round and pudgy: an oversized head merged into a plump egg-shaped body, with only a short, thick, stubby hint of a neck. It is roughly as wide as it is tall, with tiny stubby arms and short stubby legs ending in small round hooves. It has bright, saturated egg-yolk-yellow skin covered with soft, rounded caramel-brown giraffe patches, and a pale cream belly and muzzle. On top of the head are two short dark-brown ossicones (little horn-like knobs) with round tips. It also has small rounded ears sticking out to the sides, a short brown mane tuft down the back of the head, and a short tail with a brown tuft at the end. The face has small eyes squeezed shut into happy upturned arches (^ ^) and pink blush ovals on the cheeks. The mouth is gigantic, stretched almost from one side of the face to the other like a frog's grin and wide open mid-laugh, showing a dark red mouth interior, a pink tongue, and a few small white teeth. A couple of tiny tears of laughter fly off its face. Pose: standing upright with the head tilted slightly back, one hand clutching its round belly and the other arm flung up, body shaking with laughter, with a few small motion lines around the head. Style: clean vector-like illustration, thick smooth dark-brown outlines, flat color fills with minimal cel shading, simple shapes, slightly crude and silly. Full body, centered, square composition, plain pale background. No text, no watermark, no realistic fur, no 3D render, no photorealism, no other characters.
